turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail:
Their delivery policy says:
- you must contact them within 5 days of the package being marked delivered to start a trace
- traces take an average of 2 business days to complete
- they are not able to issue refunds for orders that show as delivered
- if the carrier cannot recover and redeliver the package, they can send a one-time replacement
- packages reported lost two weeks past the delivery date are not eligible for replacement
Policy details: Delivery Information

My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
If your tracking shows delivered but you don’t have the package, One Fast Cat says to wait 24 hours first, because FedEx can occasionally mark a package as delivered before it actually arrives.
If it still has not arrived after 24 hours, contact One Fast Cat so they can start a carrier trace. Their delivery policy says:
- you must contact them within 5 days of the package being marked delivered to start a trace
- traces take an average of 2 business days to complete
- they are not able to issue refunds for orders that show as delivered
- if the carrier cannot recover and redeliver the package, they can send a one-time replacement
- packages reported lost two weeks past the delivery date are not eligible for replacement
